deadline.value: December 1, 2026 application deadline for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: Application deadline: December 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Standard Time

gre_general.quote: While the GRE General Test is optional for many programs, applicants are still encouraged to submit valid GRE scores if a test has already been taken or can take the test and provide results by our application deadline, as it gives us additional information when evaluating an application.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in this field.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study and help departments evaluate applicants' readiness for graduate school.

supervisor.value: Not stated on program admission pages.

funding.value: All Chemistry PhD students receive generous stipend and tuition fellowship for duration of program.
funding.quote: All Chemistry PhD students receive a generous stipend ($36,050 for the '24-25 twelve-month academic year) and a tuition fellowship for the duration of the program.

entry_route.value: Applicants may apply directly to a PhD program with an earned bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Applicants may apply to a PhD program so long as the equivalent of a bachelor's degree is earned prior to the application semester.
